reauth_confirm.title: Kaddio token no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new administrator API token.

user.title: Kaddio organization
user.description: Use an administrator API token for an organization with the API module enabled. The address is your Kaddio address, for example myclinic.kaddio.com.

location.title: Choose room
location.description: Creates one calendar for the room (or place) you choose. Run the setup again to add more rooms.

error.invalid_base_url: Enter your Kaddio address, for example myclinic.kaddio.com
error.invalid_token: Kaddio refused the token. It must belong to an administrator at an organization with the API module.

data_description.lead_minutes: The busy sensor turns on this long before the start.
data_description.trail_minutes: The busy sensor stays on this long after the end.
data_description.event_kinds: Individual client meetings and group sessions by default. Calendar entries such as lunch are ignored unless you add them.

location_missing.title: Kaddio room was removed
location_missing.description: The room or place used by "{name}" no longer exists in Kaddio, so no bookings are shown. Remove this entry and add the integration again with another room.
